lanes.description: Deterministic host model and replay contract checks
Isolated KTEST model and focused lifecycle checks
Live multi-node Ethernet WKI message transport
Live negotiated RDMA over an ivshmem transport
Live negotiated RDMA over a RoCE transport

setup: Capture complete baseline snapshots on submitter and receiver
Enable the test-only injector with the fixed seed
workload: Submit one remote task and retain submit-session/task lifetime identity
fault: Hold receiver-side TASK_SUBMIT publication
Cancel only after one receiver worker is proven blocked
Count the exact TASK_CANCEL frame before releasing publication
heal: Release the compute publication gate after CANCEL is applied
Require the cancelled child to terminate and clear all rules
snapshot: Capture compute ownership, channel, waiter, packet-pool, peer, chaos, pipe, and IPC diagnostics
convergence: Require two stable complete post-heal snapshots within the fixed deadline

postconditions: Exactly one submit-session owner and one Task lifetime reference
CANCEL wins before receiver publication for the matching session
Both stack waiters complete exactly once

setup: Enable the injector and generic rootless QMP socket
workload: Run a remote task through exit while retaining its task and output identities
fault: Hold the old TASK_COMPLETE on the surviving submitter RX path
Reset the task owner only after the exact held-frame barrier
Prove SSH recovery plus a changed connected peer boot epoch
heal: Publish a replacement task session after recovery
Deliver the recorded stale COMPLETE while the successor exists
snapshot: Capture completion queues, task/output/IPC ownership, epochs, channels, peers, chaos, and packet pool
convergence: Require two stable complete post-reboot snapshots within the fixed deadline

postconditions: Completion queues stay bounded and session-scoped
A stale COMPLETE cannot finish a reused task ID
Task, output, and IPC exports release exactly once

setup: Mount one remote VFS export and capture complete baseline ownership snapshots
workload: Issue WRITE, UTIMENS, and RENAME followed by CLOSE
fault: Delay the exact WRITE and UTIMENS responses
Duplicate the exact WRITE request
Reorder the exact RENAME response and count the CLOSE request
heal: Release each response only after its applied barrier
Complete and verify CLOSE after all mutation checkpoints
snapshot: Capture mutation cookies, proxy/server FDs, pending operations, refs, channels, chaos, and packet pool
convergence: Require two stable complete post-close snapshots within the fixed deadline

postconditions: Each mutation is applied once
A response cookie cannot finish a successor operation
Close follows mutation and the server FD closes once

setup: Open eight remote files and capture complete baseline ownership snapshots
workload: Write and fsync one deterministic byte through each remote file
fault: Partition the first exact WRITE request until an applied barrier
Hold the first exact CLOSE request while all lane FDs remain owned
heal: Heal the WRITE partition and finish every lane operation
Release the held CLOSE and close all eight lane FDs
snapshot: Capture every lane, open-file ownership, channels, peers, and exact chaos counters
convergence: Require two stable complete post-detach snapshots within the fixed deadline

postconditions: All eight remote lane writes complete exactly once
The held CLOSE cannot strand the remaining lane FDs
All open-file and lifecycle references converge after close

setup: Open a remote pipe and capture complete baseline pipe, IPC, channel, chaos, and packet snapshots
workload: Stream a fixed byte sequence and close with expected_bytes
fault: Lose, reorder, and duplicate DATA
Delay CLOSE(expected_bytes)
Close the reader and exercise discard
heal: Release held DATA and CLOSE deterministically
Clear injection and complete teardown
snapshot: Capture exact byte counters, backlog ownership, credits, pumps, files, proxies, queues, channels, and chaos
convergence: Require two stable complete post-close snapshots within the fixed deadline

postconditions: The reader observes exact bytes with no early EOF
No backlog becomes ownerless and credits remain bounded
Pump, file, proxy references and queues reach zero

setup: Create a connected socket control session and capture complete baseline ownership snapshots
workload: Issue one cookie-scoped control operation and retain its waiter identity
fault: Hold the old socket GETPEERNAME request on the surviving home-node RX path
Reset the remote waiter after the exact applied barrier
Prove SSH recovery plus a changed connected peer boot epoch
heal: Publish a successor socket-control session after peer recovery
Deliver the old control request while the successor exists
snapshot: Capture cookies, cleanup epochs, waiters, refs, queues, peer/channel epochs, chaos, and packet pool
convergence: Require two stable complete post-reuse snapshots within the fixed deadline

postconditions: Only the matching cookie completes
References wake and release exactly once
Cleanup epoch rejects old work and the successor is unchanged

setup: Attach one remote net device through a three-node route and capture complete baseline snapshots
workload: Keep one exact managed remote-net attachment active while its periodic OP_NET_GET_STATS traffic crosses the routed middle node
fault: Drop exactly two every-second OP_NET_GET_STATS requests with an applied=2 barrier
Use QMP set_link to bring down only node 1's wki-b route leg after the periodic-rule barrier
heal: Restore the selected wki-b link and poll the exact managed binding to readiness
Detach the exact owner/resource/generation binding
snapshot: Capture attach cookies, channel generations, netdev instances, PacketBuffers, forwarding, credits, peers, and chaos
convergence: Require two stable complete post-detach snapshots on all three nodes within the fixed deadline

postconditions: The managed attachment retains one nonzero cookie and channel generation across the bounded route flap
The exact OP_NET_GET_STATS periodic rule reaches applied=2 before link-down
Exact detach proves zero active matches
PacketBuffer delta returns to baseline and forwarding plus credits converge

setup: Attach a message-mode remote block device and capture complete geometry, owner, and packet baselines
workload: Read one fixed scratch block, issue one exact message-mode WRITE, verify the baseline after rejection, and restore the scratch block
fault: Corrupt the low byte of the WRITE request block count at payload offset 12 with a valid checksum
Require the exact corruption rule to reach applied=1
heal: Prove the corrupted WRITE was rejected without changing storage
Restore the captured baseline and detach the exact binding
snapshot: Capture checked geometry, exact binding identity, operation statuses, channels, chaos, and packet pool
convergence: Require two stable complete post-detach snapshots within the fixed deadline

postconditions: The corrupted WRITE has a negative status while the adapter exits zero only after safe rejection proof
Verification observes the unchanged baseline and restoration succeeds
The message-only binding is exact and detached with no RDMA fields claimed

setup: Negotiate RDMA SQ and CQ over the selected transport and capture complete lease, tag, slot, and packet baselines
workload: Run fixed scratch-block I/O through the active ivshmem or RoCE SQ/CQ lane
fault: Corrupt the exact WRITE SQE block-count byte and require a proven-safe rejection
Duplicate one exact WRITE doorbell and require normal idempotent completion
heal: Clear between the SQE and doorbell schedules
Restore the scratch block and detach after each bounded operation
snapshot: Capture exact binding epochs, RDMA lane, ring geometry and indices, slot/tag bitmaps, channels, and chaos
convergence: Require two stable complete post-detach snapshots independently on ivshmem and RoCE within the fixed deadline

postconditions: The workload records the selected lane as exactly ivshmem or RoCE, and the matrix requires independent evidence from both topologies
Geometry and indices remain valid, SQ/CQ are quiescent, and slot/tag bitmaps return to zero
Old epoch-qualified CQE fencing remains a required KTEST proof and is not inferred from live sequence counters

setup: Clear workload/injector state, capture complete all-node baselines, and establish compute publication plus an exact managed NET binding
workload: Hold compute TASK_COMPLETE and IPC socket-control old-session tails while using exact NET, post-reset block, and VFS adapters across three nodes
fault: Reset the owner only after exact compute and IPC rules both reach applied=1
Retain old-session tails only for the compute and IPC operations that expose checkpointed successors
heal: Wait for SSH readiness and a changed connected peer boot epoch before advancing old children
Publish compute and IPC successors before releasing their stale tails, reject the old NET tuple, then prove successor NET, block, and VFS bindings
snapshot: Capture service owners, exact binding epochs/cookies, queue/reference gauges, channels, peers, chaos, and packet pool on all nodes
convergence: Require bounded complete all-node convergence after workload clear precedes injector clear

postconditions: Compute and IPC old children fail after the owner reset while both successors complete after stale-tail release
The old managed NET tuple is rejected; the successor NET tuple binds exactly and detaches
Post-reset block I/O verifies/restores one scratch block and exact VFS unmount completes; queues, refs, and packet pool converge
